Based on the provided GitHub data, here is an analysis and summary of the activity in the `ik_llama.cpp` repository. The data covers Pull Requests (PRs), Issues, and Discussions from late 2024 to mid-2025.

### 🚀 Key Performance & Feature Highlights

The `ik_llama.cpp` fork focuses heavily on **CPU inference optimization**, particularly for MoE (Mixture of Experts) models and Flash Attention (FA) on various architectures (AVX2, AVX512/Zen4, ARM_NEON).

#### 1. Prompt Processing (PP) Speedups via Repacking
The maintainer (`ikawrakow`) has implemented "on-the-fly repacking" techniques to convert standard quants into row-interleaved variants (e.g., `Q8_0` → `Q8_0_R8`) for faster CPU matrix multiplication.
